category: topology / algebraic topology; differential topology interface
canonical_claim: For a connected compact smooth h-cobordism (W; M0, M1) of dimension at least six, W is diffeomorphic relative to M0 to M0 x [0,1] if and only if the Whitehead torsion of the inclusion M0 -> W vanishes; equivalently, the inclusion is a simple homotopy equivalence.
domain_and_universes: Finite-dimensional connected compact smooth manifolds M0, M1 and W, with boundary W identified as the disjoint union of M0 and M1; exact Lean universes and manifold models remain open.
hypotheses: W is a connected compact smooth cobordism from closed M0 to closed M1
both boundary inclusions are homotopy equivalences
the smooth dimension of W is at least six
conclusion: The M0 boundary inclusion has zero Whitehead torsion if and only if the cobordism is smoothly a product relative to M0.
